notes: All demonstrated outputs are HAR/time-series classification, outside the four named task families. Feedback-driven denotes evidence-dependent pruning and subsequent feature-selection actions within a fixed four-stage schedule (L481-L489), not an open-ended retry loop. No LLM training is contributed; AutoGluon ranks statistical features and frozen encoders are off-the-shelf. Temporal validity is supported by timestamp alignment and anomaly exclusion in experimental preprocessing, not chronological or availability-time guarantees. Candidate-retention accuracy and token/latency profiling do not establish execution validity or downstream decision utility.
